The '''Pooter''' is an enemy found in {{ch|The Alley}}. Can also be summoned as a familiar through {{a|Spawn Pooter Friend}} and {{i|Botfly Larva}}.

== Behavior ==
Ranges attacker that will prioritize staying at a distance to use its Lobbed basic attack that deals {{icon|Physical Damage|#=5}} in range 3.

Has permanent {{st|Flying}}.

=== Tips ===
* If one of the player's cats has {{p|Lord of the Flies}}, this this unit will spawn {{St|Charmed}}.
* They only have a range of 3 tiles, which is shorter than most ranged attacks.

== Trivia ==
* Pooters' name and behavior come from the enemies [[tboi:Pooter|with the same name]] from ''The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth''.
** Pooters in that game had ''two'' compound eyes, however, while Pooters in this one have only one. 
*** [[Edmund McMillen]] stated that this difference in appearance stems from the original design being Issac's interpretation of them in his imagination, whereas the Mewgenics iteration is the "real" version. <ref>https://x.com/edmundmcmillen/status/2012782780216999984</ref>
* The parasite {{i|Botfly Larva}} spawns 2 Pooters upon the cat wearing the item's death. This might imply that Pooters are intended to be [[wikipedia:Botfly|Botflies]], as some kinds of Botfly larvae burst out of their host at maturity.
